sloka: तोरणस्थं महोत्साहं महासत्त्वं महाबलम् ।महामतिं महावेगं महाकायं महाबलम् ।। ५.४६.१८।।।।
transliteration: toraṇasthaṁ mahotsāhaṁ mahāsattvaṁ mahābalam ।mahāmatiṁ mahāvegaṁ mahākāyaṁ mahābalam ।। 5.46.18।।।।

translations.english: The heroic giants caught sight of the vanara, who was blazing encircled as though he was by the rays of his own glory, looking like the rising Sun. He was endowed with extraordinary agility, intelligence, and tremendous strength standing, waiting at the archway.
